scope.firewall: Every feature, event, match, label, future bar and formal artifact timestamp must be strictly before development_end_ms_exclusive; crossing future windows are incomplete and excluded.

spot.source: checksum-verified Binance Public Data monthly spot BTCUSDT 1m kline archives
spot.timestamp_normalization: detect magnitude per row; timestamps >= 10^15 are integer-divided by 1000 from microseconds to milliseconds; validate an exact 1m grid after normalization
spot.missing_rule: no interpolation, forward fill, REST backfill or synthetic bars
spot.integrity: volume >= 0; 0 <= taker_buy_base_volume <= volume plus 1e-9 tolerance; strict unique monotonic open_time

perpetual.source: checksum-verified Binance USD-M perpetual BTCUSDT canonical 1m dataset

feature.window: the 60 exact consecutive spot and perpetual 1m bars ending at the decision close; every bar must be fully closed
feature.unavailable: either 60-bar window incomplete/misaligned/gapped/future, or either summed volume <= 0

episodes.definition: maximal consecutive available 15m decisions with the same flow direction

labels.reference: OPEN of first canonical BTCUSDT perpetual 1m bar strictly after decision close

h32.statement: SPOT_PERP_TAKER_FLOW_SPREAD_1H episode onset contains directional information for subsequent BTCUSDT returns.
h32.bootstrap: UTC calendar-week cluster bootstrap at 4h and 8h
h32.support: 4h and 8h signed medians > 0; real-minus-permutation deltas > 0; bootstrap p05 >= -0.05 ATR at both; Early/Late and LONG/SHORT medians >= -0.05 at both; no leave-one-year-out exclusion flips both horizons materially negative
h32.falsification: both 4h and 8h signed medians <= 0 OR both real-minus-permutation deltas <= 0

h33.statement: Spot-perpetual flow spread adds Direction information beyond BTC contemporaneous trailing 1h price momentum.
h33.btc_baseline: trailing BTC 1h return >0 LONG, <0 SHORT, =0 NO_BIAS
h33.primary_metric: paired flow-signed minus BTC-momentum-signed return at 4h and 8h
h33.support: paired median delta > 0 at 4h and 8h; bootstrap p05 >= -0.05 at both; stratified permutation delta > 0 at both

h34.statement: Spot-perpetual flow Direction provides incremental directional information when the frozen TP/BR Opportunity Layer fires.
h34.flow_join: latest fully known flow direction as of opportunity decision close
h34.bootstrap: UTC calendar-day clustered bootstrap, separately for pooled signed return and matched candidate-control delta
h34.support: 4h/8h pooled signed medians > 0; matched deltas > 0; signed and matched bootstrap p05 >= -0.05; Early/Late and LONG/SHORT >= -0.05
h34.falsification: both pooled medians <= 0 OR both matched deltas <= 0

movement_smoke: reproduce frozen TP/BR opportunity movement counts/metrics without using legacy_pattern_side as Direction
prohibitions: Spot-only or Perp-only post-hoc formal arm

provenance.protocol_sha256: computed from the committed protocol file before formal execution
